lines.text: Sanballat and Geshem invite Nehemiah to meet on the plain of Ono, but he refuses, doing a great work.
After four invitations, Sanballat's servant brings an unsealed letter saying the Jews plan to revolt and Nehemiah will be king.
Shemaiah urges Nehemiah to hide in the temple, but Nehemiah refuses and realizes Tobiah and Sanballat hired Shemaiah.
The wall is completed in ninety days, and the surrounding nations are afraid because they realize God accomplished it.
Many in Judah are bound by oath to Tobiah, who is a son-in-law of Hanani son of Arah.
